behaviour: An amber fortified wine from Sicily, sweet or dry. A splash goes into sauces for veal and chicken and into zabaione and tiramisu. The dry kind is for savoury cooking and the sweet kind for desserts.

contains.basis: Wine may be cleared with gelatine or isinglass.
Wine may be cleared with isinglass, which comes from fish.
Wine may be cleared with egg white.
Wine may be cleared with milk protein.

safety.note: European law exempts isinglass and fish gelatine used to clear wine and beer from the labelling of fish. The stricter answer is recorded all the same.
